headline: Liquor license transfers for Pressed Café and El Jalisco Mexican Grill, a manager change at Hale Street Tavern, and four one-day licenses.
summary: Pressed Café at 900 Cummings Center and El Jalisco Mexican Grill at 150 Cabot Street seek to take over alcohol licenses. A manager change at Hale Street Tavern and Oyster Bar and four one-day license applications are also on the agenda.
items: Transfer of license from AM Restaurant Group, LLC dba Marino's to Pressed Café Beverly dba Pressed Café, manager Jessica Bassett, for all alcoholic beverages at 900 Cummings Center, Suite 100-U, Beverly
Transfer of license to Jalisco Mexican, Inc. dba El Jalisco Mexican Grill, manager Miguel A. Flores, for wine, malt beverages and cordials at 150 Cabot Street, Beverly
Change of manager from Flour N Water Corp. dba Hale Street Tavern and Oyster Bar, new manager Joseph Nickerson, for all alcoholic beverages at 717 Hale Street, Beverly
Four one-day license applications for dates from 11/6 to 11/26 at Cove Community Ctr and School of Nursing, with any more received before 3:00 pm on 11/5/2026 also considered
location: Community Room, Beverly Police Department, 175 Elliott Street, Beverly

## BEVERLY LICENSE BOARD AGENDA

**November 5, 2026**

To Whom It May Concern:

There will be a Regular Meeting of the Beverly License Board on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. in the Community Room, Beverly Police Department, 175 Elliott Street, Beverly.

1. Application for Transfer of License from AM Restaurant Group, LLC dba Marino's to Pressed Café Beverly dba Pressed Café, Jessica Bassett, manager, for the sale of All Alcoholic Beverages at 900 Cummings Center, Suite 100-U, Beverly.

2. Application for Transfer of License to Jalisco Mexican, Inc. dba El Jalisco Mexican Grill, Miguel A. Flores, manager, for the sale of Wine, Malt Beverages and Cordials at 150 Cabot Street, Beverly.

3. Application for Change of Manager from Flour N Water Corp. dba Hale Street Tavern and Oyster Bar, Joseph Nickerson, Manager for the sale of all alcoholic beverages at 717 Hale Street, Beverly.
